privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How Hypertext Studio handles information on this website.

sections.heading: Operator and scope
sections.body: Hypertext Studio operates hypertext.studio. This notice covers website visits, enquiries, email, and webmentions. Each product has its own privacy notice.

sections.heading: Data and purposes
sections.body:
Cloudflare hosts and protects this website. It receives your IP address, the page requested, browser information, and request time to deliver pages and prevent abuse.

When enabled, Cloudflare Web Analytics measures page views, referring sites, approximate country, browser and device types, and performance. It does not use cookies or track you across websites. This is separate from the information needed to deliver and protect the site.

If you email us, we receive your address, message, attachments, and anything else you include. We use them to respond, provide support, discuss requested work, and keep necessary business records. Contacting us does not subscribe you to marketing.

Where privacy law requires a legal basis, we use contract performance for agreed work, legal obligations for required records, and legitimate interests for website delivery, security, responding to enquiries, public webmentions, and permitted performance measurement. We consider your rights when relying on legitimate interests. Where consent is required for optional processing, we keep it disabled until you consent.

sections.heading: Local and hosted processing
sections.body:
The enquiry composer prepares a draft in your browser. “Email enquiry” opens your email app; you decide whether to send it. “Copy enquiry” copies the draft to your device’s clipboard. Your device settings control whether clipboard contents sync elsewhere. The composer does not send your answers to us.

Cloudflare hosts public pages and stores webmentions. Google Workspace handles email sent to us. The Studio and these providers can read email and webmention content to provide their services.

sections.heading: Recipients and AI
sections.body: Our providers are Cloudflare for the website, security, analytics, and webmentions, and Google Workspace for email. Your own email provider also handles messages you send. The enquiry composer does not use AI or send drafts to an AI provider. Products and services that use AI explain that processing in their own notices. We may disclose information when required by law or needed to protect people, investigate abuse, or handle legal claims. We do not sell personal information or share it for advertising based on your activity across different websites or apps.

sections.heading: Webmentions
sections.body: A webmention is a public reference from another website to a page here. If your site sends one, we fetch the source page to check the link. We keep its source and destination links, author information such as a name, profile link, or photo, text or excerpts, and relevant dates. Verified mentions are public and may appear beside the referenced page or through our webmention service. Send webmentions only if you intend them to be public. To request removal, email legal@hypertext.studio with the source and destination links. We can remove our copy, but not the original publication or copies held by others.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
sections.body:
We keep correspondence as needed to respond, support an ongoing relationship, meet recordkeeping requirements, or resolve a dispute. We keep verified webmentions while useful, unless removed on request or through moderation. We delete submissions that fail verification.

Hosting, security, and analytics records follow the provider’s retention rules and our service settings. Backups and caches may retain copies after active records are removed. Legal or security obligations may also require retention. Contact us to ask about a particular record or request deletion.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: We use HTTPS and access controls to protect information. No internet service or email system can guarantee complete security. Please do not send passwords, secret keys, or sensitive information unnecessary for your request.

sections.heading: Choices and rights
sections.body: We do not load optional analytics when your browser enables Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. These settings do not stop the requests needed to deliver and protect the website. We do not use advertising trackers or set tracking cookies. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or receive a copy of your information; restrict or object to its use; or withdraw consent. Email legal@hypertext.studio. We may need to verify your identity. You can also complain to your local data protection authority. Aggregated analytics do not limit your rights in other personal information.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: This general-audience website is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect their personal information. Contact us if a child has sent us information so we can review and remove it where appropriate. Product account age requirements are in each product’s terms.

sections.heading: International processing
sections.body: Hypertext Studio is based in the United States. Cloudflare and email providers may process information in the United States and other countries where they operate. Transfer safeguards depend on the service and applicable law.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
sections.body: We publish revisions here and provide additional notice when required. A change to this notice does not give us consent for a new use that requires it. Read previous policies. For privacy requests and official legal notices, email legal@hypertext.studio. For general questions, use contact@hypertext.studio. For product help, billing, security, or abuse reports, use support@hypertext.studio. Our mailing address is Hypertext Studio, 1810 East Sahara Avenue STE 75246, Las Vegas, NV 89104, United States.

terms.title: Website terms
terms.intro: Terms for using the Hypertext Studio website.

sections.heading: Operator and scope
sections.body: Hypertext Studio operates hypertext.studio. These terms cover this free website, its enquiry composer, and public webmentions. Our privacy notice explains how we handle information. If you visited this website before October 14, 2026, these terms take effect on November 13, 2026. Otherwise, they apply when you accept them. Docket, LogDate, and Curfew have their own terms. Consulting, design, development, and other paid work require a separate agreement.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: Anyone can browse without an account or purchase. If you request work for another person or organization, you must have their authority. Any agreement for paid work requires someone legally able and authorized to enter it, with a parent or guardian where required. Product account age requirements are in each product’s terms.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: This website has no visitor accounts or subscriptions. Product accounts and recovery follow the relevant product’s terms and support process.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: You own your content. You give Hypertext Studio only the permission needed to operate, secure, support, and provide the website features you choose. This includes reading an enquiry to respond and verifying, storing, and publishing a webmention’s public link, author information, or excerpt. Only provide content you have the right to share. This permission does not cover unrelated advertising or training general-purpose AI models. You can ask us to remove our copy of a webmention; we cannot remove the original or other people’s copies. The website source uses the MIT license. These terms do not limit rights granted by an open-source license. Other material remains subject to its own rights and licenses.

sections.heading: Features and connected services
sections.body:
The website describes the Studio, its work, and its products. Linked services have their own terms.

The enquiry composer prepares a draft in your browser. You can copy it or open it in your email app and choose whether to send it. An enquiry does not create a paid engagement. We agree the scope, price, and commitments separately.

sections.heading: Billing, cancellation, and refunds
sections.body: This website is free. Payments, cancellation, and refunds for Studio services follow the separate agreement and applicable law. Product purchases follow that product’s terms and the rules of the store used to buy it.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use the website lawfully and respect other people’s rights. Do not attempt unauthorized access, knowingly send malicious code, or disrupt the service. These rules do not limit open-source rights, lawful criticism, or good-faith security reports. Send security or abuse reports to support@hypertext.studio.

sections.heading: Changes and termination
sections.body: We give existing visitors at least 30 days’ notice of material changes before they apply. If law or urgent security needs require a shorter period, we explain why. Changes do not take away rights you already have or alter an earlier product purchase or services agreement. You can stop using the website at any time. We may block abusive requests to protect the site. This does not end a separate product or services agreement. Current and previous policies are in the policy history.

sections.heading: Warranty and liability
sections.body: These terms do not limit rights or liability that the law does not allow us to limit, including applicable consumer guarantees and remedies. A separate services agreement governs warranties and liability for that work. Open-source software follows its license.

sections.heading: Governing law and disputes
sections.body: Nevada law governs these terms, subject to mandatory protections where you live. Disputes are handled by courts in Clark County, Nevada, unless applicable consumer law lets you use your local courts or requires another location.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For official legal notices and privacy requests, email legal@hypertext.studio or write to Hypertext Studio, 1810 East Sahara Avenue STE 75246, Las Vegas, NV 89104, United States. Use contact@hypertext.studio for general enquiries and support@hypertext.studio for product help, billing, security, or abuse reports.
